title: Planting design | Fieldwork Garden Studio
description: Explore fictional planting design services for seasonal structure and thoughtful water use in Bend gardens.
heading: Plant for texture, movement and the seasons.
intro: This fictional planting design service explores how a garden can feel throughout the year. It is demonstration copy rather than a plant prescription for any particular property.

sections.heading: Layer the planting
sections.body: Trees, shrubs, perennials and ground covers offer different scales and textures. The example service develops a planting direction around the space available and the garden character a household wants to explore.

sections.heading: Discuss water and maintenance
sections.body: Irrigation access, soil conditions and maintenance preferences shape a useful planting conversation. Real plant selection must consider conditions on the property and qualified guidance for Central Oregon.

sections.heading: Keep the plan understandable
sections.body: A fictional handoff explains the role of each planting area and identifies decisions that still need local verification. No survival rates, water savings or performance outcomes are claimed.
